title: TradingView-like 1D/4H timeline year markers and full-year crosshair
changes: Always show calendar year on the bottom timeline, even while browsing a single month of older 1D or 4H data.
Draw explicit YYYY at year transitions, readable month changes and decluttered dates based on pixel spacing, not a label per candle.
Use Asia/Taipei date parts for 4H midnight and New Year transitions.
Crosshair shows complete YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm timestamp with a wider badge.
Year markers pan with K lines; current visible date-year context remains pinned on the axis.
Do not modify any historical pagination, Pionex/Worker, CoinGlass, 1D/4H indicator or RR calculation.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite five files under MultiAssetLiquidityRadar on GitHub. No Cloudflare Worker deployment needed.
validationNote: Chromium synthetic 1D/4H and cross-year timeline verification; live deployment not tested.
